requirements.description: Review exact package/source facts in part.copper and README, including input/output ratings and conditions.
Review manufacturer reference, footprints, critical copper, returns, current capacity and thermal implementation.
Validate startup, switching, short circuit and interrupted load with actual parasitics; unsupported models remain open.
Measure waveform, temperature and fault response across operating extremes before release.
Review peak/RMS current, dissipation, contact and copper temperature rise, SOA and fault-energy capacity in the actual consumer circuit.

notes: Pinout verified. Review VDD4.5–18V, bypass, UVLO, 3V3 input margins, gate-loop ringing and active turnoff timing.

sources.locator: SLUSAY4D December 2014, pin functions and operating conditions
